interests.title: Rough paths & signatures
interests.text: Branched and Volterra signatures, algebraic structures of path signatures, and representations of non-Markovian dynamics.

interests.title: Stochastic analysis
interests.text: Stochastic differential and integral equations, noise estimation from observed trajectories, and mathematical finance.

interests.title: Machine learning
interests.text: Signature kernels, learning from irregular data, volatility modeling and calibration, and signature methods for optimal control.

papers.title: Branched Signature Kernel Solvers for ODEs with Rough Single-Trajectory Signals
papers.authors: Munawar Ali, Qi Feng, Charlie Pyle, and George Xu
papers.summary: A kernel approach to solving differential equations when the forcing is known through just one observed, potentially rough trajectory.

papers.title: Branched Signature Model
papers.summary: A framework for learning with branched signatures, connecting their approximation properties to geometric signatures of extended paths.

papers.title: Noise Estimation of SDE from a Single Data Trajectory

papers.summary: Recovering stochastic dynamics and noise from a single observed path without assuming stationarity or ergodicity.
